title: Tencent/WeKnora
title_zh: 知识框架 WeKnora — 转换文档为活知识的 RAG、代理和自动维基

paragraphs.en: Open-source LLM knowledge platform: turn raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki.
paragraphs.zh: 开源 LLM 知识平台：将原始文档转化为可查询的 RAG、一个自主推理的智能体，以及一个自我维护的 Wiki。

paragraphs.en: Overview · Quick Start · What's New · Features · Clients · Docs · Development
paragraphs.zh: 概览 · 快速开始 · 新增内容 · 功能 · 客户端 · 文档 · 开发

paragraphs.en: WeKnora is an open-source, LLM-powered knowledge framework for enterprise document understanding, semantic retrieval and reasoning. It brings a team's documents together so they can be searched, reasoned over and kept up to date.
paragraphs.zh: WeKnora 是一个开源的、由大语言模型驱动的知识框架，用于企业文档理解、语义检索和推理。 它将团队的文档汇集在一起，使这些文档可以被检索、进行推理，并保持更新。

sents.en: WeKnora is an open-source, LLM-powered knowledge framework for enterprise document understanding, semantic retrieval and reasoning.
sents.zh: WeKnora 是一个开源的、由大语言模型驱动的知识框架，用于企业文档理解、语义检索和推理。

sents.en: It brings a team's documents together so they can be searched, reasoned over and kept up to date.
sents.zh: 它将团队的文档汇集在一起，使这些文档可以被检索、进行推理，并保持更新。

paragraphs.en: Use RAG to look things up, the agent for multi-step tasks, and the wiki to organize knowledge. All three work on the same knowledge bases.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 RAG 来查找资料，用智能体处理多步骤任务，用维基来组织知识。 这三者都基于相同的知识库运作。

paragraphs.en: The agent's toolbox. Skills installed from ClawHub / SkillHub / Git / ZIP run in session-persistent Docker / E2B / Cube sandboxes, with an interactive terminal and graphical desktop beside the chat. Through the BrowserSkill extension the agent operates the user's own Chrome or Edge, and external MCP services (OAuth included) can be connected and enabled tool by tool.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的工具箱。 从 ClawHub / SkillHub / Git / ZIP 安装的技能运行在会话持久的 Docker / E2B / Cube 沙箱中，聊天界面旁还有交互式终端和图形桌面。 通过 BrowserSkill 扩展，智能体可以操作用户自己的 Chrome 或 Edge 浏览器，外部 MCP 服务（包括 OAuth）可以逐个连接并启用工具。

A walkthrough with sample data is in the Quickstart .

paragraphs.en: Agents can operate the browser on your computer, knowledge bases can be published to other AI tools over MCP, and a running conversation can be steered, forked or rewound.

paragraphs.en: Two ways to ask. Quick Q&A answers from the knowledge base with RAG and cites the sources it used. In smart reasoning the agent plans multi-step work, searching, reading documents and calling tools and skills, and shows each step in the conversation. Docs →
paragraphs.zh: 两种提问方式。 快速问答通过 RAG 从知识库中检索答案，并引用其使用的来源。 在智能推理模式下，智能体会规划多步骤工作，进行搜索、阅读文档以及调用工具和技能，并在对话中展示每个步骤。Docs →

paragraphs.en: Automatic wiki Documents organized into a browsable wiki. With Wiki enabled, WeKnora extracts people, products and concepts from knowledge-base documents into pages with source citations, organized by directory. The knowledge graph shows how pages relate; pages can be edited directly and every change can be rolled back. Docs →
paragraphs.zh: 自动 Wiki 文档以可浏览的 wiki 形式组织。 启用 Wiki 后，WeKnora 会从知识库文档中提取人物、产品和概念，生成带来源引用的页面，并按目录组织。 知识图谱展示页面之间的关联；页面可以直接编辑，且每次更改都可以回滚。文档 →

paragraphs.en: Architecture A modular pipeline from document parsing, vectorization and retrieval to LLM inference, in which every component can be replaced or extended. It runs locally or on a private cloud, and the Web UI needs no setup to get started. More: Architecture overview · RAG pipeline · Extension points .
paragraphs.zh: 架构：从文档解析、向量化与检索到大语言模型（LLM）推理的模块化流水线，其中每个组件都可以替换或扩展。 它可以在本地或私有云上运行，Web UI 无需任何配置即可上手使用。 更多内容：架构概览 · RAG 流水线 · 扩展点。

paragraphs.en: weknora is the official CLI for driving the API from a terminal or an AI agent. It is agent-first : every command emits a stable JSON envelope by default (with typed error codes mapped to exit codes), and --format text renders for humans. It also serves a curated MCP tool surface ( weknora mcp serve ) and ships bundled Agent Skills.
paragraphs.zh: weknora 是用于在终端或智能体中驱动该 API 的官方 CLI。 它是智能体优先的：每个命令默认输出稳定的 JSON 信封（带有映射到退出码的类型化错误码），而 --format text 则以适合人类阅读的方式呈现。 它还提供了一个精选的 MCP 工具面（weknora mcp serve），并内置了打包的智能体技能。

paragraphs.en: weknora profile add prod --host https://kb.example.com --use weknora auth login weknora kb list weknora link --kb my-knowledge-base # bind the current directory weknora doc upload notes.md weknora chat " summarise the design doc " For headless / CI use, set WEKNORA_API_KEY + WEKNORA_HOST and skip auth login ; no credentials are written to disk. See cli/README.md for install + 5-minute quickstart and cli/AGENTS.md for the operational contract AI agents rely on.

paragraphs.en: The documentation site and product homepage are built from website-docs/ . With Node.js 24, run cd website-docs && npm run setup && npm run build && npm run preview to preview both together; the unified static output serves the homepage at / and documentation at /docs/ . See the directory's README for Nginx and Docker deployment.

paragraphs.en: Welcome to submit Issues or Pull Requests.
paragraphs.zh: 欢迎提交 Issues 或 Pull Requests。

paragraphs.en: For a focused PR, validate the changed scope first:
paragraphs.zh: 对于聚焦的 PR，请先验证变更范围：

paragraphs.en: git fetch origin main git diff --check origin/main...HEAD golangci-lint run --new-from-rev=origin/main ./... go test ./path/to/changed/package -count=1 Run gofmt on changed Go files before committing. For frontend changes, run the relevant tests from frontend/ and use npm run type-check when the change affects TypeScript or Vue components.
paragraphs.zh: git fetch origin main git diff --check origin/main...HEAD golangci-lint run --new-from-rev=origin/main ./... go test ./path/to/changed/package -count=1 在提交之前对更改的 Go 文件运行 gofmt。 对于前端更改，请从 frontend/ 运行相关测试，并在更改影响 TypeScript 或 Vue 组件时使用 npm run type-check。

paragraphs.en: make fmt make lint make test make fmt formats the entire Go repository, so run it only with a clean worktree and review the resulting diff. Some full-suite tests require local infrastructure or service configuration. If a full check fails for an unrelated baseline or environment reason, include the exact command and failure in the PR while still providing passing targeted tests for your change.
paragraphs.zh: make fmt make lint make test make fmt 会格式化整个 Go 代码仓库，因此请只在工作区干净时运行，并检查产生的 diff。 一些完整套件测试需要本地基础设施或服务配置。 如果完整检查因无关的基线或环境原因失败，请在 PR 中包含确切的命令和失败信息，同时仍为你的更改提供通过的目标测试。
